description:
Re-enable a paused strategy (manual re-enable after a drawdown pause).

The drawdown kill switch latches a strategy to
``paused_drawdown`` and requires this explicit owner action to resume; the
equity high-water mark is reset so it does not immediately re-trip.

 (spec s7.1): resuming a PERPS-CAPABLE strategy (perp_grid /
basis_trade / allow_short / short_only) re-runs the perps jurisdiction
gate first -- a wallet whose jurisdiction no longer passes (US / unknown /
expired / OFAC / AU) cannot re-engage a paused perps strategy.
name: strategy_resume
